mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 over the past 6 months signals robust demand growth, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or GDPC1 growth decelerates below 2% MoM in the subsequent quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing above 10.0% signals labor market tightness and wage inflation, reducing corporate profitability and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 10.0%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous low FEDFUNDS rate and elevated HOUST demand indicator create a favorable monetary and demand environment, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and HOUST > 600 units, or the interaction effect is not statistically distinct from zero.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and enhancing equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (p > 0.05) during a late-cycle expansion when FEDFUNDS decline, or the effect is not regime-specific.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO index falling below 95.0 signals weakening supply conditions, prompting market overvaluation fears and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite INDPRO falling below 95.0, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (labor participation) signals robust economic activity, enhancing corporate profitability and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and PAYEMS show upward trends, or the interaction effect is not statistically distinct from zero.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly FEDFUNDS rate exceeding 4.0% during a tightening cycle signals aggressive monetary policy tightening, increasing borrowing costs and pressuring equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% in a tightening cycle, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO over the past 6 months signals improving supply conditions, reducing market overvaluation concerns and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (p > 0.05) during the 60-day horizon despite sustained INDPRO growth, or the effect is not regime-specific.
